description: Known-defect test failures that scripts/check-test-report.mjs tolerates in a full Vitest JSON report. Each entry names one failing test, the finding that causes it and the fix-plan task that must remove the entry. A ledgered test that passes is reported as STALE and fails the check.

entries.test: cancels source application between files and preserves the durable partial result
entries.reason: apply throws PORTAL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED (K1) before the write hook this test waits on, so it reaches its 60 s timeout, which Vitest 4 reports as STACK_TRACE_ERROR.
